scripts.check:node22: node -e "const major=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if(major!==22){console.error('ERROR: Node 22 is required. Run: nvm use'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.dev: if [ -x /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node ]; then /opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin/node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev -p 3010 --webpack; else next dev -p 3010 --webpack; fi
